lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section, becoming slightly more condensed at the posterior rump transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One distinct bifurcation observed on the 7th line from the anterior, splitting into two segments at the ventral boundary. Minor merging of lines 9 and 10 near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1 and 2 at the shoulder and line 12 at the hip are abbreviated, failing to traverse the full vertical width of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of three high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch, situated superior to the stifle joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Short, straight spike-like projections oriented at an approximate 70-degree angle relative to the skull's longitudinal axis; absence of lyrate curvature.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated apical distance is 1.8x the cumulative width of the horn bases.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes and two distinct white spots on the lower cheeks. White band present on the forelimbs above the carpal joint.
